mostWorthwhile.text: Building both cell types was worthwhile because their different genes and protein locations made the same-DNA, different-jobs idea concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The supporting-cell pathway repeated the muscle pathway closely, so its first step felt somewhat predictable.

surprise.text: The supporting cells released protein into their surroundings, while the muscle proteins formed bundles inside cells.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but how the development signals select genes was not explained; I followed the named pairings rather than understanding that mechanism.

continue.text: I would continue to see how these different cells become tissues and organs, though I hope the next chapter offers less parallel repetition.
